items.title: Make build-check help safe to inspect
items.why: Current main has no help guard; isolated reproduction will distinguish help from sanitizer execution before repair.
items.recipe: Reuse cli-contract help before every operational branch. Extend isolated process fixtures with spawn tripwires, byte snapshots, flag precedence and normal/self-test controls.
items.acceptance: Both help aliases print documented options without sanitizing, spawning, locking or changing receipts; normal and self-test lanes remain operational.
items.userOutcome: Maintainers can discover verification options without starting or mutating a release verification run.
items.stageRationale: Repair demonstrated operator reliability failures before the authorized promotion.

items.title: Observe file changes in merge closeouts
items.why: Live readCommits sees200 commits but the real SIL merge anchor has no paths in default git log --name-only output.
items.recipe: Observe merge file changes explicitly using Git diff semantics, retaining complete anchor-bounded history and fail-closed behavior. Prove real merge, ordinary closeout and later unrecorded work with temporary Git repositories.
items.acceptance: Real merge closeouts produce an observable SIL anchor; subsequent substantive work still becomes debt; live S407 triage can be measured without inventing recovery.
items.userOutcome: Maintainers can find the actual last closeout without launching false recovery work.
items.stageRationale: Repair demonstrated operator reliability failures before the authorized promotion.
